queries:
WITH per_event AS (
    SELECT link_to_event, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM budget
    WHERE amount IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY link_to_event
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg
    FROM per_event
),
kept AS (
    SELECT p.link_to_event, p.avg_amount
    FROM per_event p, overall o
    WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg
),
kept_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS kept_avg
    FROM kept
)
SELECT k.link_to_event,
       k.avg_amount,
       k.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS diff_overall,
       k.avg_amount - km.kept_avg AS diff_kept
FROM kept k, overall o, kept_mean km
ORDER BY diff_kept DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING AVG(x.cost) >= (SELECT AVG(cost) FROM expense);
SELECT AVG(avg_amount)
FROM (
    SELECT AVG(b.amount) AS avg_amount
    FROM event e
    JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
    GROUP BY e.event_id
)
WHERE avg_amount IS NOT NULL;
SELECT link_to_event
FROM budget
GROUP BY link_to_event
HAVING AVG(spent) > (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM budget);
